greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uJesu Kristu nani nonke.
penitential:
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi.
Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso ohlala unamathele engqondweni yam xa ndicinga ngoBenjamin Vo. Hayi indiza ebaleka esibhakabhakeni, hayi ikhompyutha ayeyikodileyo, kodwa umzuzu othi cwaka ekhitshini. Khumbula umfanekiso kaBen ehlezi phantsi, enxibe iibhulukhwe zakhe eziluhlaza, ephethe isilawuli somdlalo, amehlo akhe ecinga nzulu ngento ethile ebalulekileyo. Kwakukho ukuzola okumangalisayo kulo mfana. Wayengumfana owayebona ihlabathi ngenjongo, owayefuna ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu ukuya kwindlela yokwakha 'con chim airlines' yakhe—kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encane eyayiqonda ukuba uthando luyinto yokwenziwa, hayi yokuthethwa nje.

Namhlanje, kulo Mkhosi woMnqamlezo oNgcwele, iLizwi likaThixo lisibuyisela emva kwixesha, kwintlango apho abantu bakaSirayeli babephulukene nethemba. Bathi kuMoses, 'Kutheni usizisile apha ukuba sife?' Babesele bediniwe, bediniwe kukuhamba, bediniwe kukutya okufanayo. Bahlaba ikhwelo lokukhalaza. Kwaye uThixo, ngendlela emangalisayo, wathi kuMoses, 'Yenza inyoka yobhedu, uyiphakamise emthini.' Lowo wayeyijongile, wayephila. Lo mfanekiso ubonakala ungaqhelekanga kuthi namhlanje, kodwa uYesu usicacisela wonke umyalezo kwiVangeli: 'Njengokuba uMoses wayiphakamisayo inyoka entlango, kananjalo uNyana woMntu umele aphakanyiswe.'

Masime kancane apha. Kutheni uMnqamlezo? Kutheni uYesu kufuneka aphakanyiswe? UMnqamlezo awungomfanekiso wokufa kuphela; ngumfanekiso wothando olungazigcineliyo nto. UYesu, 'nangona wayekwimo kaThixo,' akazange azibambe loo nto, kodwa wazithoba. Waba ngumkhonzi. Wathatha intlungu yethu, wathatha ukoyika kwethu, wathatha nokufa kwethu, wazibeka phezu komnqamlezo. UMnqamlezo uthi kuwe namhlanje: 'Andikushiyi wedwa.'

Alan noThao, iinyanga ezintathu zidlulile ukususela oko uBen wagodukayo. Ndiyazi ukuba usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazi ukuba usizi lufana nomthwalo onzima ongena ngaphakathi kwindlu yakho ngaphandle kokungqongqoza. Niyazibuza, 'Kutheni uBen? Kutheni umfana onentliziyo elungaka, owayenomdla wokunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam ngemali yakhe, kufuneka ahambe?' Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule amazwi am: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayekuthanda kakhulu, kwaye uthando lwakhe lwalumsulwa njengaloo mthombo wamanzi owakhiwe egameni lakhe eCà Mau. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo.

UYesu, xa wayebuzwa malunga nendoda eyayizalwe iyimfama, wathi akukho mntu wonayo. Ubomi buhamba ngeendlela esingazaziyo. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayakha isiseko sayo edwaleni. Ukholo lwakhe, ububele bakhe, uthando lwakhe—konke oku kwakuyisiseko esomeleleyo. Xa isiphango sezifo size, loo ndlu ayizange iwe. UBen usekhululekile ngoku. Akasabandezeleki. Usebanquet yasezulwini, ecaleni kukaSaint Carlo Acutis, owayenomoya ofanayo nowakhe. UBen usekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Namhlanje, xa ubona umnqamlezo, ungaboni nje intlungu. Bona uthando. Bona uYesu owaphakanyiswa ukuze akutsalele kuye. UBen, ngoku, ungowalapho uYesu akhoyo. UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yami uJesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, kwaye ndizinikela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlulwe kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisibusise, isigcine ebubini, ize isikhokelele kubomi obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abaselizini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwane: Njengomzimba omnye onamalungu amaninzi, kwaye onke amalungu omzimba, nangona esininzi, engumzimba omnye, kunjalo ke nakuKristu. Kuba ngomoya omnye sonke sabhaptizelwa emzimbeni omnye, nokuba singamaJuda okanye singamaGrike, singamakhoboka okanye singabantu abakhululekileyo, kwaye sonke saphiwa ukusela uMoya omnye. Ngoku umzimba awulolungu elinye, kodwa ngamaninzi. Ngoku nina ningumzimba kaKristu, kwaye ngabanye ningamalungu awo. Abanye abantu uThixo ubatyunjile eBandleni ukuba babe, okokuqala, Abapostile; okwesibini, abaprofeti; okwesithathu, abafundisi; emva koko, imisebenzi yamandla; emva koko izipho zokuphilisa, uncedo, ulawulo, neentlobo zeelwimi. Ngaba bonke bangabaPostile? Ngaba bonke bangabaprofeti? Ngaba bonke bangabafundisi? Ngaba bonke benza imisebenzi yamandla? Ngaba bonke banazo izipho zokuphilisa? Ngaba bonke bathetha ngeelwimi? Ngaba bonke bayatolika? Zamani ngokuzimisela izipho eziphakamileyo zokomoya.

readings.label: IHubo
readings.text: R. Singabantu bakhe: izimvu zomhlambi wakhe. Hlabani imikhosi yeNkosi, nina nonke mihlaba; khonzani iNkosi ngovuyo; yizani phambi kwayo ngeculo lovuyo. R. Singabantu bakhe: izimvu zomhlambi wakhe. Yazini ukuba iNkosi inguThixo; yasidala, singabayo; singabantu bayo, umhlambi ewulalusayo. R. Singabantu bakhe: izimvu zomhlambi wakhe. Ngenani emasangweni ayo ngokubulela, kwiinkundla zayo ngokudumisa; yibuleleni; yibusiseni igama layo. R. Singabantu bakhe: izimvu zomhlambi wakhe. Kuba iNkosi ilungile, inceba yayo ihlala ngonaphakade, nokuthembeka kwayo, kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana. R. Singabantu bakhe: izimvu zomhlambi wakhe.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Emi ngase mnqamlezweni kaYesu yayingunina, nodadewabo kanina, uMariya umfazi kaKlowpa, noMariya Magdala. Xa uYesu wabonayo unina nomfundi amthandayo emi apho, wathi kunina, 'Mfazi, naba unyana wakho.' Emva koko wathi kumfundi, 'Naba unina.' Kwaye ukususela ngelo lixa umfundi wamthatha wamfaka ekhaya lakhe.

day: Memorial of Our Lady of Sorrows

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.
